title: An RPG Mobile Game with Real Food Rewards? WendyQuest Just Dropped
summary: Get a sneak peak of Wendy’s new video game and all the fun waiting for you
body_markdown:
Ready to take a step into WendyQuest and test out the game for yourself? Here’s a taste of the gameplay action, enemies and bosses:


- **Fryshire:** Wendy’s initial journey finds her forging through the Crispy Forest and Tater Fields, defeating Soggy Snakes, Lil Salty and others along the way.
- **Sweet North:** Next she takes on the ills of ice cream from Hot Sludge Sundae with a frosty face-off.
- **Chicken Sands:** Foil the Heat Lamps and Blandbats leading up to a dual battle between Chicken and Nuggets
- **Breakfast Isles:** Just like it says, this region is all breakfast villains—make it through the Baconflop before the ultimate breakfast showdown.
- **Beef Bluffs:** The final region sees Wendy battling her biggest nemeses in a beefed-up battle.


The best part of defeating each region boss is that progress unlocks five chances to earn REAL Wendy’s food offers, redeemable through the Wendy’s app while supplies last. Because let’s be real, the best rewards are also edible. To redeem, just copy the promo code (it’s in your “inventory” bag in the game), and enter it into the “offers” section of the Wendy’s app.


- **Fry Stone** - Free medium fry with purchase
- **Frosty Stone** - Free small Frosty® with purchase
- **Chicken Stone** - Free 10 piece nuggs with purchase
- **Breakfast Stone** - Free biscuit or croissant with purchase
- **Beef Stone** - Free Dave’s Single® with purchase


Ready to claim your loot?[Learn more](https://www.wendys.com/wendyquest?utm_campaign=2026-wendys-quest&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=pr&utm_content=GM-wendys-quest) or get started by downloading WendyQuest free for[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wendyquest/id6480134807) or[Android,](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.monkeys.freshquest) or play on[PC via Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339970/WendyQuest_Legend_of_the_Four_Corner_Stones/) beginning today, November 4.


*Open to U.S. residents 18 years of age or older. Reward Codes are available on a first-come, first-serve basis and while supplies last. Wendy’s account registration required to redeem codes in the Wendy’s App. Reward Codes expire seven (7) days after redemption.*
